title: Billing escalations RACI (v0.3 draft)
content:
Billing escalations RACI - v0.3 (DRAFT, not approved)

Context: trying to pin down who owns billing asks that land in support. Still waiting on Finance review. Billing Ops isn't staffed yet, so a lot of this is interim.

R = does the work, A = owns/approves, C = consulted, I = informed

| Case | R | A | C | I |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Invoice dispute / wrong line | Support | Finance | CSM | - |
| Duplicate invoice line | Support | Finance | Telemetry | - |
| Refund request | Support | Finance | - | CSM |
| Token count doesn't match customer's count | Telemetry | Telemetry | Support | - |
| Goodwill credit | CSM | CS lead | Finance | - |
| "What does my contract / SLA say" | AE | Sales | Legal | CSM |
| Usage missing from Console | Support | Telemetry | - | - |

Open questions:
- once Billing Ops exists do invoice cases move there? (Rishi thinks yes)
- goodwill credits: can the CS lead approve small ones or does everything go through FP&A? need a ruling
- who owns metering correctness - telemetry or a billing eng group? Logan: telemetry owns the pipelines, not billing logic

Notes to self: circulate after Finance review. Don't link from Confluence until approved.
